IncidentBot: [P1] Lucerna Biosystems - dedicated-cluster-12 eu-west-1: elevated 5xx rate on inference API (5m error rate 23%). Pager sent to oncall.
Maria G. (oncall): ACK. I’m on the page. Starting triage now. @Kevin O. can you confirm if recent deploys touched cluster-12? :eyes:
Kevin O. (SRE): No deploys to cluster-12 in last 6h from release pipeline. Seeing an increase in 503s from grpc-proxy logs, likely backend saturation on node set 12-a.
Samir R. (Eng): I’m pulling KV cache metrics and model-serve queue lengths. Initial glance: KV cache evictions spiked ~18:03 UTC, tail latency for gpt-3.5-quant up 3x.
Maria G. (oncall): Ok. Prioritize mitigation: 1) scale up 12-a by +2 GPUs, 2) enable fallback routing to dedicated-standby for Lucerna accounts, 3) issue status page + customer comm draft. Kevin, can you trigger scale now? :thumbsup:
Kevin O. (SRE): Scaling node-group cluster-12-a +2 g4dn now (autoscaler override). ETA 4m. Also enabling emergency throttling policy for long sequences for that node-group to shed load.
Samir R. (Eng): Patching proxy to increase max concurrent streams from 200 -> 300 for cluster-12 in case of connection pileup. Rolling patch to 12-a only to reduce blast radius.
Maria G. (oncall): Noted. Preparing customer-facing language. Jenna, can you review the Lucerna-specific notification (short, action-oriented)?
Jenna Park (CS): Reviewing. Add account-specific impact: Lucerna production ingest to inference pipelines may see degraded latency and elevated failure rate for embeddings and reranks. We should list primary contacts to route followups.
Maria G. (oncall): Draft status page snippet below — please review/edit:
```
Status: Degraded performance for Redwood Dedicated (eu-west-1)
Impact: For a subset of Dedicated customers (including Lucerna Biosystems), inference requests may return 503/504 or experience high latency. We are actively scaling the affected GPU pool and routing traffic to standby capacity. No data loss.
Mitigation: Scaling and proxy adjustments in progress. Expected recovery within 15–30 minutes. Updates every 10 minutes.
``` 
Kevin O. (SRE): Good. I'll post that to status. Also attaching quick contact routing list for Lucerna below.
Maria G. (oncall): Lucerna contacts (for CS + oncall routing):
- Primary infra: infra@lucerna.com (pager: +1-415-555-0132) — Rafael M.
- Platform lead: platform@lucerna.com — Hana S. (cc: jpark@redwood.com)
- Account exec: j.park@redwood.com (Jenna Park)
- Escalation: legal-security@lucerna.com (only if data exposure suspected)
Samir R. (Eng): Internal runbook checklist snippets I'm following:
- Confirmed no code rollback needed
- Scaled cluster nodes
- Enabled fallback routing for Lucerna tenant IDs -> dedicated-standby pool
- Increased proxy concurrent streams on 12-a
- Watching KV cache hit rate and per-model tail latency
Maria G. (oncall): Customer email template (short) — Jenna please adapt tone and send via account team once approved:
```
Subject: Incident: Temporary performance degradation for Lucerna (eu-west-1)
Body: Hi Hana / Rafael,
We’re investigating elevated error rates impacting inference for your Dedicated cluster in eu-west-1. You may see 503 errors or slower responses for embeddings and reranking. Our engineers have scaled the cluster and routed traffic to standby capacity; we expect recovery within ~30 minutes. We will send updates at 10-minute intervals. If you need immediate assistance, reply to this thread or call +1-415-555-0132.
Apologies for the disruption — Maria G., On-call, Redwood Inference
``` 
Jenna Park (CS): Template looks good. I'll send after first recovery-check update. Also flagging legal & product for visibility: @Product Ops please note customer impact wording.
Product Ops: Seeing this — please hold on outward-facing blog or broader comms until we have full resolution.
SLOWatcher: Alert: dedicated-cluster-12 SLO breach window triggered at 18:05 UTC. Tracking metrics for postmortem. :warning:
Kevin O. (SRE): Scale applied, new nodes ready. Proxy patch rolled to 12-a, no obvious errors during rollout. Early signs: 5xx rate dropping to 8% over last 2 minutes.
Samir R. (Eng): KV cache eviction rate back down, tail latency trending toward baseline. Keeping fallback routing active for an extra 15 minutes.
Maria G. (oncall): Great work team. Jenna send the customer email now with 'we're monitoring' language. I'll update status page with next tick (in 10m). Leaving this thread open for handoff to next oncall in 30m.
Jenna Park (CS): Sent to Hana and Rafael. Copying account exec. Will update when we have full recovery.
IncidentBot: Incident severity changed to mitigated by Maria G. — automated note.
Maria G. (oncall): Marking for follow-up postmortem: include root cause analysis for KV eviction spike, capacity tuning for dedicated pools, and a customer comm timeline. Assigning to Samir for RCA draft. Closing live coordination after confirmation of stable metrics.
Samir R. (Eng): I’ll take RCA. Starting notes now. Will loop in Product Ops and SRE for timeline.
Maria G. (oncall): Thanks. Signing off for now. :white_check_mark:
